svg.title: Tracked spider access platform — Beltaknúinn kóngulóarpallur
svg.desc: A narrow tracked access machine spreads four stabilizers and carries a small basket on an articulated boom.
svg.metadata: {"collection":"UteamUP Construction and Building","subject":"build-tracked-spider-platform","label_en":"Tracked spider access platform","label_is":"Beltaknúinn kóngulóarpallur","section":"02","category_en":"Lifting, access and site logistics","category_is":"Lyftingar, aðgengi og flutningar á verkstað","batch":1,"tags":["access","spider-lift"],"description":"A narrow tracked access machine spreads four stabilizers and carries a small basket on an articulated boom.","design_note":"A personnel basket, folding arm and splayed stabilizers distinguish this access platform from the hook-equipped mini crane.","style":{"viewBox":[0,0,24,24],"stroke":"#1655A6","stroke_width":0.9,"fill":"none","background":"transparent"}}
